q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: SELECT B.FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, B.FOLLOWER AS NUM FROM (SELECT FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS FOLLOWEE FROM FOLLOW GROUP BY FOLLOWER) AS A INNER JOIN (SELECT FOLLOWEE, COUNT(FOLLOWER) AS FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW GROUP BY FOLLOWEE) AS B ON A.FOLLOWER = B.FOLLOWEE ORDER BY FOLLOWER ASC
